function.name: FGET_ANGLE
function.param: X coordinate of the first point
Y coordinate of the first point
X coordinate of the second point
Y coordinate of the second point
function.abstract: Calculate the angle formed by the line between two spots

description.p: This function returns, in thousandth of degree, the angle formed by the line betweem two specified spots, and the axis X (horizontal) of coordinates.

With that function we can, easily, to orient the angle of a process so that it will be always "watching" towards a concrete place (like it can be other process). The easiest application can be a process that "persecutes" to other simply using FGET_ANGLE and ADVANCE.
